title: Caeser Syllables
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 5 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 7 \times 10^6; 1 \leq K \leq 2300; 0 \leq A_i \leq K-1 (1 \leq i \leq N); V_j \in \{0,1\} (0 \leq j \leq K-1); 0 \leq \mathrm{seed} \leq 2^{60} - 1; 1 \leq M \leq \min(N, 10^5); 0 \leq b_i \leq K-1 (1 \leq i \leq M); All input values are integers.
